interpretation_boundaries: This audit checks the evidence recorded by the frozen harness, not a new execution or an independent re-evaluation of RDF/SHACL answers.
The same frozen harness and settings are used on both binaries. Binary and output paths and kernel identities are intentionally different.
Successful semantic comparisons include warmups. Failed and skipped records provide no successful semantic digest or before/after speedup.
The before 1M fanout stage has no successful sample; its after digest can be checked against its oracle but cannot be paired with a successful before sample at that scale.
Session reuse counts cover successful validation requests including warmups; mounts and failed/skipped requests are excluded from those counts.
Each session mount is one diagnostic observation. Session request timing excludes that one-time mount; file transport includes per-call preparation.
OS caches were not flushed; raw reports carry the cache and scratch policies. These samples do not establish cold-disk latency, P95/P99, production concurrency or Full 100M capacity.
Small repeated samples support descriptive results, not statistical significance or a general claim that every join has constant memory or latency.

Temporary artifact paths are excluded from content equality; pack kernel identity is excluded because the measured engine intentionally changes. All recorded content/source/profile digests and logical/allocated bytes are still compared.
